decision_order: Read and verify the two pinned source archives.
For the ordinary target, strict control, and tight control, form all six potential slacks and the eligible set.
Apply both frozen rules without reading complementary-runner state.
Issue no more than one compound containment query per rule. If both rules choose the same pair, one physical calculation may be reused but counts logically for both rule budgets.
If containment holds, report the already-known five-edge lower bound C_0-O_cd. If it fails, preserve the first exact violation and do not retune or query another pair.
For tight_13, if the eligible set is empty, issue no containment query and report the already-archived isolated equality t=3/8 separately from duration.

For doubling_112, the archived positive pair-only optimum exits before selector use. Evaluate the two frozen rankings and their one-query outcomes only as labelled diagnostics; they do not replace or strengthen that exit.
